steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease.
Combine beef, water, tomatoes, corn, tomato sauce, carrots, celery, onion, bouillon, ketchup, basil, and salt in a large stockpot; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for at least 1 ½ hours.

raw_recipe.headline: Hamburger Soup
raw_recipe.description: This hearty hamburger soup is an easy but flavor-packed meal made with lean ground beef in a savory broth with diced tomatoes and colorful veggies.
raw_recipe.name: Hamburger Soup

recipeInstructions.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease.
Combine beef, water, tomatoes, corn, tomato sauce, carrots, celery, onion, bouillon, ketchup, basil, and salt in a large stockpot; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for at least 1 ½ hours.

review.reviewBody: I made this exactly as stated the first time and found it a bit bland. The second time I added two cloves of garlic, used 28 oz. diced tomatoes and 14 oz. tomato sauce, 4 c. beef broth, 1 c. mushrooms and 1 c. peas and it made a huge difference - everything else was the same. I have also tried this once with ground bison and it was fantastic!!!

Thank you for the recipe. My husband and I enjoyed it and we will for sure make this again. I needed to make some changes , only because I did not have on hand all items needed. I substituted one box of beef stock for the bullion cubes/water part of the recipe, and used 32 oz cans of tomato sauce and diced tomato's. I added 1tsp garlic powder. I cooked this in my crock pot for 6 hours.

This was yummy, but I tweaked the recipe a little. First off, I made 7 cups of beef broth. I used Italian Stewed tomatoes instead of regular. Then I added a bag of frozen mixed vegetables. I also added 1 tsp of ground black pepper and 1 1/2 tsp of Italian seasoning. Then I added a can of drained red beans. I allowed it to cook, then at the end, I added a package of bow tie pasta and allowed it to cook until tender. Yummy!

Took others' advice and used seasoned diced tomatoes--green pepper with onion. Used a frozen onion/celery/red & green pepper/parsley mix and a frozen corn/green bean/carrot mix. Easy! Used low sodium beef broth (omitted the water, of course). Seasoned with a pepper blend I love from Penzey's called Forward. Forgot to add the ketchup, using only tomato sauce, but it had a wonderful flavor. It was a hit at a potluck. Thanks!

I used frozen veggies from the garden and home canned stewed tomatoes and tomato sauce instead of store bought but it's a good recipe that was quick and easy. I put it all in the crock pot at lunchtime and it was ready to eat at supper with cornbread. Added to my recipes so I can make it again.

i loved it. I added a few extra things though. i added all ingredients except diced tomatos and i added two cloves of garlic (and i sauted the onion and garlic in light butter before i added them), i added only half the corn and added chopped broccoli. i simmered the soup for about half an hour and added chopped cabbage and cooked for another hour. it was delicious i already added this to my recipe book, thanks for this recipe

I made this... used up leftover meat... I chipped celery, onion, and carrots in food chopper ... I used canned tomatoes diced with basil and onion but I still put in everything called for in this recipe, basil and onion same amounts... I had 2/3 cup rice in fridge so I threw that in also, it didn’t change anything by doing that just used up my leftovers!... I had this together in 5 mins!!! Put it in my pressure cooker and cooked on high for 16 minutes!!! Absolutely delish!!! Adding this to my list of regular foods!!!

I loved the soup. I kept all the ingredients the same except i cooked the hamburger with half the onion until it caramelized. I drained the grease and added a heaping tablespoon of garlic, heaping teaspoon of basil, used 2T better than bouillon, and served it over rice with shredded Parmesan on top. I am sure it was very tasty just as written but my husband and I like the extra flavor from caramelizing the onion with the beef. Next time might add a bell pepper. 

It’s a keeper for sure.

I love this recipe because of the hamburger as I am not much of a beef eater otherwise. I did add other vegetables to mine like potatoes and green beans and I also added barley to it which really made it good.

Great recipe. We tripled it, added potatoes and went 1lb each of hamburger, hot Jimmy dean sausage and regular Jimmy dean sausage. Also used Italian seasoning instead of just basil and Rotel instead of plain diced tomatoes 🤙🏼

I didn’t have corn, but I had fresh kale I sliced thinly and added toward the end of cooking. I used tomato paste (I keep a tube in fridge) instead of ketchup, and I also spiced it up. I cooked my potatoes and carrots in a bit of olive oil in the microwave before adding to soup to speed the cooking process.
Did not care for it. It might have been the ketchup. I don’t know.

I love this recipe!! I have been making this since i was a teenager which feels like ages ago. I change things here or there depending on what my guests or daughter is wanting. Usually will either add chopped cabbage or noodles when i dont have any dinner rolls on hand. Its a very easy delicious recipe whether done as is or not!!
I used a bit more onion, and used salt and pepper. It was great
I used tomatoes with chillies for a little extra kick. Also used beef broth with just two flavour cubes. Easy and yummy.
Doubled the liquid and subbed the water with broth. Added oregano, time and garlic. Also added sausage and egg noodles. 👌
Added a couple small red potatoes and a few dashes of Worcestershire sauce. Next time, cut down on amount of water to make a little thicker.
I added beef broth, chopped red pepper, some Worcestershire, red kidney beans in the last 20 minutes of cooking, and some broken spaghetti….
My husband says this is the best soup he's ever had. I did add a can of green beans and a can of diced potatoes. Yummy 😋
